title: Talent Acquisition Specialist / IT Recruiter
description:
**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a Senior Recruiter to own end\-to\-end hiring for technical roles across TechGrit and our client engagements. This is an individual\-contributor role for someone who can work independently: take a requirement from intake to offer with minimal supervision, manage multiple open roles in parallel, and act as a trusted hiring partner to delivery leaders and clients. You will build pipelines for hard\-to\-fill technical profiles, keep candidate quality high, and bring structure and data to how we hire.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**End\-to\-End Recruitment** 




 •      Own the full recruitment cycle independently — requirement intake, JD creation, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and pre\-joining follow\-up.
 



 •      Manage 8–12 concurrent open positions across technology stacks (.NET, Java, MERN, Cloud/DevOps, QA, Data, AI/ML, Mobile) and seniority levels up to Architect and Engineering Manager.
 



 •      Conduct first\-level technical and cultural screening to ensure only well\-matched profiles reach technical panels and clients.
 



 •      Drive offer closure — compensation discussions, counter\-offer handling, and notice\-period management to minimise drop\-offs.
 



**Sourcing \& Pipeline Building** 




 •      Source actively through Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, Hirist, job boards, referrals, and professional communities; run boolean and X\-ray searches for niche skills.
 



 •      Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring and hard\-to\-fill roles so that shortlists can be shared within 48–72 hours of a new requirement.
 



 •      Coordinate with external recruitment partners and interview\-panel vendors — share briefs, review submissions, and track vendor performance.
 



**Stakeholder \& Client Management** 




 •      Partner with delivery leaders and hiring managers to understand role needs, calibrate profiles, and advise on market availability and compensation.
 



 •      Present candidates to clients with clear, well\-structured profile summaries and manage client interview scheduling and feedback loops.
 



 •      Work across India and US time zones as needed to support client\-facing hiring.
 



**Process, Data \& Candidate Experience** 




 •      Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records in the ATS / hiring tracker and report weekly on pipeline status, time\-to\-fill, source effectiveness, and offer\-acceptance rates.
 



 •      Prepare candidates for technical and client interviews so they present their experience accurately and confidently.
 



 •      Ensure a timely, professional, and transparent candidate experience at every stage.
 



 •      Contribute to improving recruitment processes, screening frameworks, and employer\-branding initiatives; use AI tools to speed up sourcing, screening, and outreach.
 



**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 




 •      5–8 years of recruitment experience, with at least 4 years hiring for IT / software engineering roles in a product, services, or IT staffing company.
 



 •      Proven track record of independently closing mid\-to\-senior technical positions end\-to\-end.
 



 •      Solid understanding of technology stacks and roles — able to read a JD and a resume and judge technical fit before a panel does.
 



 •      Strong sourcing skills across Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other channels, including boolean search.
 



 •      Excellent communication and negotiation skills; comfortable engaging with senior candidates, hiring managers, and clients.
 



 •      Highly organised and self\-driven — able to prioritise multiple requirements and meet tight turnaround times without close supervision.
 



 •      Working proficiency with ATS tools, MS Excel / Google Sheets, and MS Office.
 



 •      Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA / PG in HR is a plus.
 



**Preferred Skills** 




 •      Experience hiring for US or international clients, including client\-facing candidate submissions.
 



 •      Exposure to niche hiring — Cloud Architects, AI/ML engineers, Data engineers, or Mobile engineers.
 



 •      Experience managing recruitment vendors and interview\-panel partners.
 



 •      Hands\-on use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) in the recruitment workflow.
 



 •      Familiarity with recruitment metrics and building hiring dashboards.
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 •      The opportunity to own hiring for a growing AI\-first engineering organization, with real influence on who joins and how we hire.
 



 •      A collaborative, ownership\-driven culture where independent work and initiative are valued.
 



 •      Competitive compensation aligned with experience and market benchmarks.
 



 If you are interested in this opportunity, please share your resume at hr@techgrit.com

title: IT Recruiter
description:
**Company Name: Insight Global** 




**Role: Technical Recruiter** 




**Location: Hyderabad, India** 




**Shift Timings: Day Shift (12\-9pm IST)** 




  





*\*\*MUST BE BASED IN HYDERABAD. This role will be fully onsite Mon\-Fri in HiTEC City.\** 




  





 Insight Global is one of the world’s largest staffing firms. What does that mean? We make hiring easy for our clients. Since 2001, we’ve expanded from a small entrepreneurial startup to over $4 billion in revenue. Our growth is driven by our award\-winning company culture, comprehensive training programs, and of course, our people.
 



  





**WHO WE ARE** 




 We look for motivated, competitive, passionate individuals with high expectations for what they and their company can achieve together. Our best performers combine high aspirations for themselves and their team with their passion for helping others in our purpose\-driven, sales\-team environment.
 



  





 Your role will be dedicated to having a candidate\-first mindset while doing all that we can to help our talented candidates find their next role. We’re not just filling a business need for our clients but instead changing the lives of thousands of people we put to work every year in India. Grow in your career while helping others find careers of their own. It begins with you.
 



  





**PROFESSIONAL RECRUITER** 




 When it comes to Professional Recruiting, think next\-level recruiting. Recruiters are experts in their craft, focused on job seekers and our consultants. Their job is to identify top talent, then work to pair those candidates with the perfect job.
 



 Once the placement is made, our Professional Recruiters continue to work closely with each consultant guaranteeing a world\-class experience and offering continued support throughout their careers. Our Professional Recruiters accounted for over 80% of our job placements last year.
 



  





**MUST HAVES** 



* 2\+ years of Technical Recruiting experience
* Career longevity and proven track record of performance
* Experience in full lifecycle recruiting (sourcing, screen, onboarding, and consultant management) in the India market
* Background and willingness to be in a high\-call volume environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Basic computer skills (Email, Microsoft Teams, PowerPoint, Excel, Microsoft Word)
* Experience using job boards or other recruiting platforms (Indeed, LinkedIn, Dice, Monster, Naukri, Career Builder)
* Strong understanding of pay rate negotiation
* Bachelor’s degree or higher
* Flexible hours may be needed to support customers in different time zones



  





**PLUSES** 



* Previous staffing company experience
* Experience with technical recruiting outside of the India market



  





**WHO WE HIRE** 



* **Talent Focus:** 
 We’re focused on hiring the best talent. We look for individuals with grit, leadership potential, and a competitive spirit. If you’re driven, personable, and embody our Shared Values, you’re the right fit.
* **Personality:** 
 Strong personalities who are positive, charismatic, and willing to connect with others
* **Hustle \& Grit:** 
 Resilient individuals who push beyond limits, pursue long\-term goals, and perform well under pressure
* **Team:** 
 Team\-first mindset—everything is possible when working together
* **Culture:** 
 Our Shared Values define us: Everyone Matters, We Take Care of Each Other, Leadership is Here to Serve, High Character \& Hard Work Above All Else, Always Know Where You Stand
* **Recruiting Mindset:** 
 Motivated, excited about recruiting as a long\-term career, with behaviors such as Urgency, Competitiveness, Directness, and Relentlessness



  





**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS** 




 Insight Global offers a competitive base salary along with an uncapped commission model.
 



 Professional Recruiters have the opportunity to win annual sales contests, including all\-expenses\-paid trips to the Bahamas and a year\-end cash bonus. Benefits include health insurance, accident and disability coverage, gratuity, Flexi Benefit plans, office perks, and more.

title: Talent Acquisition Sourcing Specialist [T500-29620]

Through our MSP, RPO, Direct Sourcing, Services Procurement and Consulting services, we help organizations find, engage, and manage the best permanent and contingent talent across the globe.
 



 Part of Impellam Group, we champion A Better Way, a people\-first approach that integrates deep industry expertise with advanced technology. Our technology turns workforce complexity into clarity, with real\-time insights that support smarter talent decisions at scale.
 



 With over 1\.5 million STEM and professional experts in our network across 80\+ countries, we don't just solve today's challenges. We're helping to shape the workforce of tomorrow.

 At Guidant Global India, we play our part in shaping the future of work by powering recruitment and support services for Guidant teams across APAC and wider global markets. As a strategic delivery hub and global capability centre, we partner with stakeholders worldwide to raise quality, strengthen compliance, and deliver consistently at scale.
 



 We're not standing still. We're building deeper capability in\-house, taking ownership of the work that matters most, and designing an agile, future\-ready delivery model built for where the business is heading next.
 



 Join us, and you'll be part of a people\-first team that's expert, ambitious, and collaborative, delivering A Better Way, every day.
 



  





**About the Talent Management Team:** 



* Talent Management spans the full external workforce lifecycle \- from sourcing and recruitment through to compliance, onboarding, and candidate care. In this function, you will work across a range of specialist disciplines: sourcing and screening candidates across global markets, managing pre\-employment screening and right\-to\-work compliance, coordinating contractor onboarding and documentation, supporting supply chain and audit activity, and maintaining the data integrity that underpins every placement. Roles include Recruiter, Senior Recruiter, Recruiter Team Leader, Compliance Coordinator, and Operations Coordinator \- with scope to specialize in recruitment delivery, compliance and PES, or operational coordination depending on your background. Operating from the Hyderabad GCC, you will work closely with onshore account teams and hiring managers across UK\&I, Europe, Americas, and Asia\-Pacific, contributing to service standards that matter to real clients in real time. If you want to build expertise across the talent and compliance lifecycle and grow in a structured, performance\-driven environment, Talent Management is where that journey starts.

* Treating people with respect and by the company's equal opportunity and unacceptable behaviour policy.
* Behaving in a manner that does not put the safety and integrity of you, others, the environment, or the company at risk.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Candidates – Sourcing, Screening \& Candidate Care:** 



* Sift and shortlist candidates against open requisition criteria, using the CRM / ATS to manage the process end\-to\-end.

* Use CRM data and MI to progress candidates from initial application through to offer.

* Maintain contact with placed candidates on a regular basis to ensure they remain happy with the role and the service provided.

 Join us, and you'll be part of a people\-first team that's expert, ambitious, and collaborative, delivering A Better Way, every day.
 



  





 The Sales Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for accelerating profitable growth across the India market by originating, shaping, and closing complex opportunities for HeadFirst Global's GCC and workforce solutions. The role engages confidently with senior client stakeholders, translating business and workforce challenges into differentiated, outcome\-led propositions that demonstrate measurable value, return on investment, and long\-term partnership potential. Working closely with the VP \- Sales and cross\-functional leaders, the role develops territory and account strategies, applies disciplined sales processes, maintains a high\-quality pipeline and forecast, and navigates multi\-stakeholder buying cycles from initial engagement through commercial negotiation and handover. The Senior Sales Executive brings strong market judgement, consultative and value\-selling capability, commercial acumen, and customer advocacy to strengthen client trust, expand strategic relationships, and consistently deliver revenue and margin objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and execute territory, segment, and target\-account strategies aligned to India growth priorities, ideal customer profiles, and revenue objectives.
* Originate and qualify high\-value opportunities through executive networks, referrals, strategic partnerships, market intelligence, events, and focused outreach.
* Build trusted relationships with C\-suite, procurement, HR, talent, finance, and operational stakeholders, mapping influence, decision criteria, and buying dynamics.
* Own the full sales cycle for complex opportunities, from discovery and opportunity strategy through proposal, negotiation, contracting, and transition to delivery.
* Consistently achieve or exceed revenue, gross\-margin, new\-logo, pipeline coverage, and conversion objectives while protecting commercial quality.
* Represent HeadFirst Global as a credible market voice at senior client forums, industry events, and strategic networking platforms.



  





**Client Engagement \& Solutions:** 



* Lead executive\-level discovery to uncover strategic priorities, operational pain points, risk considerations, decision criteria, and measurable success outcomes.
* Apply consultative and value\-based selling methods to connect HeadFirst Global's capabilities with client outcomes, including productivity, compliance, scalability, experience, cost optimization, and speed to value.
* Orchestrate cross\-functional solution design with Sales, Customer Success, Talent Management, Finance, Legal, and Operations, ensuring propositions are differentiated, deliverable, and commercially sound.
* Develop and present compelling business cases, proposals, and executive presentations that articulate value, return on investment, commercial logic, and implementation confidence.
* Lead complex negotiations across scope, commercials, service levels, risk, and contract terms, maintaining client trust while protecting margin and governance standards.
* Act as a customer advocate by bringing client insight into solution development, mobilizing internal support, and setting clear expectations that enable long\-term value realisation



  





**Pipeline Management \& Reporting:** 



* Maintain rigorous CRM discipline, complete opportunity data, and clear next\-step ownership across all active accounts and deals.
* Build and manage a balanced, stage\-appropriate pipeline with sufficient coverage, prioritizing opportunities by strategic fit, value, probability, timing, and margin potential.
* Apply the agreed sales methodology and qualification framework consistently, using evidence\-based deal reviews to identify risks, remove blockers, and improve conversion.
* Provide accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts, clearly articulating assumptions, dependencies, decision paths, and recovery actions.
* Use data, market intelligence, and AI\-enabled sales tools to improve account prioritization, research, outreach personalization, pipeline insight, and forecast quality while applying appropriate judgement and data safeguards.
* Provide actionable insight on market trends, competitors, buying behaviour, customer needs, and proposition gaps to inform commercial strategy and portfolio development.



  





**Governance \& Collaboration:** 



* Operate within the delegation of authority, pricing, margin, contractual, compliance, and ethical frameworks; escalate exceptions early and with clear recommendations.
* Lead internal deal governance for priority opportunities, aligning stakeholders on win strategy, solution, commercials, risks, approvals, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate a disciplined handover to Customer Success and delivery teams, ensuring commitments, assumptions, risks, success measures, and stakeholder expectations are documented and understood.
* Partner effectively across functions and geographies to mobilize expertise, remove barriers, and present one integrated HeadFirst Global experience to the client.
* Share winning practices, market insight, and constructive coaching with colleagues, contributing to continuous improvement in sales capability, process, and performance.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Substantial B2B solution\-sales or business\-development experience, preferably in staffing, MSP, RPO, GCC, workforce solutions, technology\-enabled services, or professional services.
* Demonstrated record of winning new logos, meeting or exceeding revenue and margin targets, and closing complex, multi\-stakeholder opportunities.
* Strong proficiency in sales strategy, territory and account planning, consultative and value selling, opportunity qualification, commercial negotiation, and disciplined sales\-process execution.
* Advanced pipeline management and forecasting capability, with strong CRM discipline and the ability to convert data into practical deal and portfolio decisions.
* Credibility and confidence engaging C\-suite and senior functional leaders, with excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
* Commercial acumen with the ability to develop business cases, articulate return on investment, understand pricing and margin implications, and balance customer value with organizational outcomes.
* AI fluency, including effective and responsible use of AI\-enabled tools for research, account intelligence, prospecting, personalization, proposal development, productivity, and sales analysis; able to validate outputs and protect confidential data.
* Strong customer\-advocacy orientation, with evidence of representing the customer voice internally, resolving barriers, and building relationships that support retention, expansion, and referrals.
* Sound understanding of the India commercial and workforce landscape, including relevant client buying dynamics, market trends, and regulatory considerations.
* High levels of ownership, resilience, judgement, collaboration, and adaptability in a fast\-growing, matrixed environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or a related field; relevant advanced study or professional sales certification is advantageous.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* The opportunity to shape commercial growth across India's major metropolitan markets and represent a differentiated GCC and workforce solutions portfolio.
* A high\-impact senior individual\-contributor role with access to executive stakeholders, strategic opportunities, and international expertise.
* A collaborative, ambitious, and customer\-led culture that values performance, ownership, innovation, and responsible use of technology.
* Competitive compensation, performance\-based incentives, and clear opportunities for continued professional and leadership development.

* Ensure compliance with internal hiring processes.

* ATS Compliance
* Pipeline Development

 TNS India Foundation (TNSIF) is a section 25, non\-profit development organization that has been active in India since 2012\.  We are seeking an experienced Principal Analyst to own the strategy, configuration, integration, and support of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition (ATS) platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, deep hands\-on expertise across all Taleo modules and features, and proven experience delivering full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementations. * Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles, coordinate defect resolution, and manage go\-live readiness.

* Proficiency with XML, CSV, and data integration techniques, along with web services and APIs.

* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**Position Profile:** 




 The contents of this role profile outline the role and responsibilities of the Talent Acquisition Sourcing Specialist.
 



  





**About Us:** 




 Head First Global PLC is a leading international HR\-tech and workforce solutions platform, connecting highly skilled professionals with organizations across Europe, the UK, the US, and APAC. The organization has entered a new phase of accelerated growth and transformation following its combination of Headfirst Group and Impellam Group. Backed by private equity, the group is executing an ambitious buy\-and\-build strategy, strengthening its position as a global market leader in flexible workforce solutions. We are embarking an ambitious transformation in the global workforce solutions industry—shifting at pace to a bold, differentiated platform model that will redefine how businesses and talent access, manage, and engage in work of the future.
 



  





**Overview :** 




 The Talent Acquisitions Sourcing Specialists serves as an essential partner to the Talent Acquisition Consultant, directly driving candidate generation and pipeline health to accelerate time to fill for roles. Operating at the front end of the recruitment life cycle, this position focuses on identifying, attracting, and engaging both active and passive talent through advanced sourcing techniques, market research, and targeted outreach. By conducting initial candidate evaluations and continually align search strategies with the TA Consultant, the TA Sourcing Specialist ensures a steady flow of high calibre candidates whilst evaluating overall efficiency and candidate experience of the hiring process.
 



  





**Key Duties and Responsibilities:** 




 Duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to the following tasks, criteria, and attributes to successfully perform the position of the Talent Acquisition Sourcing Specialist.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Proactively identify and map active and passive candidates using advanced Boolean logic, Linked in Recruiter, job boards, niche networks, and talent databases
* Assist in the recruitment and selection process by effectively engaging with candidates and by screening database applicants.
* Liaising with candidates / hiring managers to arrange interviews and sending out invites for roles as directed by the TA Consultant
* Ensure all aspects of talent acquisition are fully inclusive and proactively encourage and attract candidates from diverse groups by engaging with affiliated groups, memberships, and accreditations.
* Provide a first class, seamless candidate experience, conduct rigorous phone screens and evaluation to align with role specifications, technical capability, and candidate career motivations before passing candidate to the TA Consultant or Hiring Manager
* Research, identify, and proactively approach candidates using all appropriate methods.
* Qualify, and present suitable candidates by screening candidates.
* Assist in the development of candidate pipelines for key business functions.
* Use social media, email, and telephone to maintain engagement with top talent.
* Provide follow\-up feedback to candidates via phone and email. Key Skills
* Direct sourcing experience on LinkedIn and multiple Job Boards
* Strong understanding and experience with Boolean searches
* Experience working with ATS platforms.
* Excellent communication skills
* Sound knowledge of Microsoft Office software.
* Ability to priorities and manage own workload.
* Reliable and well organized
* Proactive
* Sound business ethics and integrity.
* Able to work well under pressure.
* Team player with a flexible and confident approach to work



  





**Key Relationships:** 



* Partner dynamically with the Talent Acquisition Consultant throughout the recruitment lifecycle, participating in hiring manager intake meetings



  





**Ideal Experience:** 



* Proven Talent Sourcing Track Record: 2\-4 years of dedicated candidate sourcing, talent acquisition, or agency recruitment experience, with demonstrated success in identifying and engaging candidates.
* Advanced Sourcing Expertise: Practical expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search logic, candidate mapping, and alternative candidate discovery channels.
* Recruitment Tech \& Systems: Direct hands\-on experience utilizing Application Tracking Systems (ATS) and Candidate Relationship Management (CRM) tools (e.g. SuccessFactors, Workday, Recruitee) with high data accuracy.
* Stakeholder \& TA Alignment: Experience participating in briefing calls, calibrating candidate profiles against job requirements, and collaborating closely with TA Consultants or Senior Recruiters to drive shared hiring targets.
* Candidate Screen \& Engagement: Proven background conducting structured telephone or video screening interviews to access functional competencies, cultural alignment, and candidate motivators.
* Market Research \& Analytics: Demonstrated capability in compelling candidate landscape insights, talent market mapping, and utilizing sourcing metrics (conversation rates, channel efficiency) to optimize search strategies.



  





**Personal Characteristics:** 



* Curious \& Methodical: Processes a natural investigative mindset to dig beyond surface level keywords, uncover hard to find talent pools and continuously test new sourcing approaches
* Resilient and tenacious: Demonstrates high perseverance when navigating competitive talent markets and perusing passive candidates who may initially be non\-responsive
* Relationship Driven: Empathetic and engaging communicator who builds immediate rapport with candidates and establishes trust quickly with internal team members
* Agile \& Adaptative: Thrives in fast paced environments, effortlessly shifting focus across multiple requisitions and adapting strategies as business priorities evolve
* Data informed \& Analytical: Organized and detail orientated, using metrics and candidate feedback to track personal productivity and refine outreach methods
* Collaborative Partner: High team\-oriented with a strong service mindset, focused on supporting the TA Consultant to achieve collective hiring goals rather than working in isolation.

title: Human Resources Recruiting Specialist
description:
Job Summary
 



 SRR Projects Pvt Ltd is looking for an experienced HR Recruiter with strong expertise in infrastructure and construction recruitment. The candidate should have hands\-on experience in sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing positions for civil construction and infrastructure projects.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for infrastructure, civil construction, commercial and residential building projects.
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Handle recruitment for Civil Engineers, Site Engineers, Senior Engineers, Project Managers, QS \& Billing Engineers, MEP Engineers, QA/QC, Safety, and other construction\-related positions.
* Understand project requirements, job descriptions, experience criteria, and site locations.
* Screen resumes based on relevant construction experience, technical skills, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period.
* Coordinate with project teams, HODs, and hiring managers for interview scheduling and feedback.
* Conduct initial HR screening and maintain regular follow\-ups with candidates.
* Manage candidate pipelines and ensure timely closure of open positions.
* Coordinate salary negotiations, offer releases, and candidate joining follow\-ups.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, interview status reports, and daily/weekly hiring updates.
* Support onboarding coordination and joining formalities.



 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 


* Any graduate; MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.
* 4–8 years of experience in HR recruitment, specifically in infrastructure or construction.
* Strong knowledge of civil construction and building project recruitment.
* Hands\-on experience with Naukri, LinkedIn, Boolean searches, and other sourcing platforms.
* Good communication, negotiation, and candidate management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and meet recruitment deadlines.
* Strong coordination skills with site teams and project management teams.



 Candidate Preference
 


* Candidates with recruitment experience in infrastructure, construction, residential, commercial, or high\-rise building projects only.
* Immediate to 15 days' notice period preferred.

title: TA Manager
description:
Insight Global is one of the world's largest staffing firms. What does that mean? We make hiring easy for our clients. Since 2001, we've expanded from a small entrepreneurial startup to over $5 billion in revenue. Our growth is driven by our award\-winning company culture, comprehensive training programs, and of course, our people.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 We are seeking a high\-energy, strategic Talent Acquisition Manager who will build and scale our internal TA engine from the ground up. This role is responsible for designing and owning the full TA roadmap for India – from internal processes and employer branding to candidate experience, campus strategy, and team leadership – while directly supporting high\-priority hiring across IT, Solutions, Delivery, and Recruiting/Sales roles. You will operate as both a builder and a doer: someone who can create the vision, design the playbook, and then roll up your sleeves to execute, iterate, and scale. This is a high\-impact leadership role for a culture\-first people leader who embodies Insight Global’s Shared Values and can build a high performing team. At Insight Global, we don’t recruit like everyone else, and we don’t want to. The right person for this role will think creatively, challenge traditional campus hiring approaches, and help redefine what great recruiting looks like at scale.
 



  





 RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  




* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across priority hiring needs for the Hyderabad delivery center as well as campus hiring strategy. Ensure strong alignment to business demand, hiring quality, and speed across technical, delivery, solutions, and fresh graduates across sales/recruiting.
* Proven track record of building or scaling TA processes, programs, or teams from the ground up – including design, rollout, and continuous improvement of recruiting operations, tools, and governance.
* Serve as a strategic talent acquisition partner to leaders across India and the US by aligning on hiring priorities, calibrating expectations, and ensuring a consistent, collaborative approach across teams and stakeholders.
* A builder’s mindset: creative, solutions\-oriented, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and excited to design something new rather than just maintain existing processes.
* Build, execute, and continuously improve scalable campus recruiting strategies aligned to business growth. Develop and maintain strong relationships with career centers, faculty, and student organizations across target universities in India.
* Organize and lead on\-campus and virtual recruitment events such as career fairs, walk in drives, information sessions, hackathons, and branding initiatives.
* Willingness to travel within India for campus engagements and key market events as needed.
* Bring ideas, market insight, and strategic recommendations to every phase of the hiring process—from intake and sourcing strategy through interviews, offers, and conversion—so the function continues to improve and evolve.
* Build and strengthen interview process governance by helping define clear recruiting workflows, interviewer expectations, assessment standards, feedback quality, and decision\-making consistency across the hiring lifecycle. Provide market insights, talent trends, and data\-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions.
* Track and report on key recruiting metrics (time\-to\-hire, conversion rates, campus ROI, etc.)



  





 WHAT WE LOOK FOR
 


* 8\-12 years of full\-cycle recruitment experience, including significant ownership of mid to senior\-level hiring in India, ideally within high\-growth or services\-focused organizations. Experience hiring across technical (IT), Solutions, or Delivery\-based roles, non\-IT with an emphasis Sales/Recruiting roles preferred.
* 5 Years of Team Handling Experiences.
* Proven experience operating as a lead/manager and can both execute and develop hiring
* processes, influence stakeholders, and elevate how the organization attracts and selects talent.
* Strong track record of high activity, strong metrics, and operational excellence.
* Experience enhancing employer brand and talent market reputation by representing the
* company externally, shaping candidate messaging, and supporting or leading branding initiatives
* and events.
* Creative, solutions\-oriented mindset with a history of bringing new ideas, tools, and approaches
* to sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and conversion across the entire hiring lifecycle.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills.
* Self\-motivated with strong organizational and project management abilities.
* Willingness to travel for campus engagement events as needed.
* Demonstrates high character, grit, and a positive, team\-oriented mindset.

title: Technical Recruiter (Contract)
description:
**Summary**
 Do you have a passion for helping others succeed? Do you genuinely believe that talent is the greatest asset of any company? As a member of Apple’s People group, you’ll help discover and develop our most important resource: our people. Together, we’ll search the world to build our collective of talented perfectionists, visionaries, and inventors. All the while, your efforts will maintain Apple as the most innovative company by striving to make us the most diverse — open to all people, all backgrounds, and all perspectives. And that’s just the beginning, because throughout Apple employees’ careers, you will continue to help them grow professionally and support them in work and life. Join the team and help build and keep the extraordinary talent it takes to make extraordinary products.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Technical Recruiter / Engineering Recruiter to join our team in Hyderabad on a contract basis. This role is responsible for providing the highest level of recruiting partnership to Apple's business leaders and candidates through our sourcing and selection processes, performing full lifecycle recruitment while maintaining excellent relationships. You will have the opportunity to work with an amazing, robust, and agile team responsible for hiring world\-class talent. Apple has an exciting, high\-performance culture. If you are results\-driven, a self\-starter, and ready to "Think Different," come join us!
   

  

 In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in identifying, attracting, and hiring top\-tier technical talent across various high\-demand domains. You will act as a strategic partner to our hiring managers, leveraging market intelligence and data\-driven insights to build exceptional teams that drive our innovation and success. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, possess a keen eye for talent, and are dedicated to delivering an outstanding candidate experience, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 This is a contract position.
   

  

**Description**
 As a Corporate Recruiter, you will be the cornerstone of our technical hiring efforts, owning and driving the end\-to\-end recruitment process for critical engineering and product roles.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
 Strategic Talent Sourcing: Proactively source, engage, and attract top\-tier technical talent from diverse channels, employing creative and effective strategies to build robust pipelines. You'll be the go\-to person for finding the right profiles.
   

  

 Full\-Cycle Recruitment \& Candidate Engagement: Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial candidate engagement through offer negotiation and onboarding, ensuring a seamless, positive, and engaging experience for all candidates.
   

  

 Hiring Partner Alignment: Conduct comprehensive intake meetings with hiring managers and leaders to deeply understand hiring profiles, define success metrics, and collaboratively develop effective sourcing and hiring strategies.
   

  

 Market Intelligence \& Advisory: Provide data\-backed insights on talent market availability, competitive compensation trends, and hiring best practices to influence and guide strategic hiring decisions. Data Analysis \& Process Improvement: Analyse key recruitment metrics (e.g., conversion rates, time\-to\-source, time\-to\-hire) to evaluate pipeline health, identify bottlenecks, and proactively suggest process enhancements and optimizations.
   

  

 ATS Management \& Communication: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records within our Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring smooth communication and efficient workflow throughout the recruitment journey.
   

  

 Special Projects \& Initiatives: Actively participate in and contribute to various talent acquisition and people\-related special projects, helping to shape and refine our overall recruiting strategies and employer brand.
   

  

 Continuous Learning: Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and innovative sourcing techniques to maintain a competitive edge in the talent market.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of full\-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong preference for candidates who have worked within the Technology sector
* Have a well\-developed network of candidates and/or the skills to build the network quickly and comprehensively


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a global or rapidly scaling organisation.
* A passion for technology and staying abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and talent landscapes.
* Certifications in recruitment best practices or relevant recruiting tools.
* Experience with employer branding initiatives or talent marketing.
* Proven track record of successfully hiring for high\-demand, specialised technical roles such as Software Engineering (Backend, Frontend, Full Stack), Product Management, Data Science, Machine Learning, or similar.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up, manage a high volume of requisitions, prioritise effectively, and operate autonomously to consistently hit challenging hiring targets.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and consultation skills, with a proven ability to build strong relationships and partner effectively with senior Hiring Managers and Leaders.
* Expertise in utilising Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter for sourcing and engagement.


 At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.
   

  

 Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

description:
**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.** 
 is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
 **Good Health Can’t Wait.**




 We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.
   

  





 For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
   

  





 ‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
   

  





 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Onboarding Experience Partner \- End\-to\-End Onboarding \& Day 1 Experience
   

  





  

  





 We are looking for a proactive, empathetic, and detail\-oriented professional to serve as the single point of contact for candidates throughout their onboarding journey, from Interview Selection to successful Day 1 Onboarding and Reporting.
   

  





 The role is responsible for managing the complete candidate onboarding lifecycle, including candidate engagement, offer acceptance support, onboarding coordination, Background Verification , Pre\-Medical management, Joining \& Relocation, Day 1 induction readiness, compliance governance, and employee experience management to ensure a seamless, compliant, and engaging onboarding experience.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities

* Proactively engage with candidates to drive readiness, confidence, and joining commitment.

* Support offer acceptance, relocation, joining formalities, and pre\-joining queries.



 Operational Excellence \& Governance
   

  




* Manage Background Verification , Pre\-Medical, documentation, and onboarding compliance processes.
* Track onboarding readiness and maintain governance dashboards and trackers.
* Monitor onboarding SLAs and ensure timely closure of activities.
* Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to resolve bottlenecks and escalations.



 Day 1 Experience Management
   

  




* Ensure complete Day 1 readiness, including system access, assets, workspace, and induction arrangements.
* Facilitate virtual and in\-person Day 1 induction programs.
* Troubleshoot onboarding issues and drive timely resolution.
* Deliver a smooth and memorable first\-day employee experience.



 Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Hiring Managers, IT, Facilities, Security, Payroll, Finance, Admin, Vendors, and Business Leaders.
* Provide onboarding insights, updates, and risk assessments to stakeholders.
* Influence decisions and drive accountability across cross\-functional teams.



 Continuous Improvement
   

  




* Identify process gaps and recommend automation and experience enhancement opportunities.
* Analyze onboarding metrics and trends to improve candidate conversion and onboarding effectiveness.
* Contribute to transformation and employee experience initiatives.



 What We're Looking For
   

  





 Essential Skills
   

  




* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and risk\-management capabilities.
* High attention to detail and process orientation.
* Passion for employee and candidate experience.



 Preferred Experience
   

  




* Experience in End\-to\-End Onboarding, HR Operations, Candidate Experience, Recruitment Coordination, Employee Experience, or Shared Services Operations.
* Familiarity with BGV, Pre\-Medical, Documentation, Joining Formalities, Day 1 Induction, and HR compliance processes.
* Hands\-on experience with HR systems and onboarding platforms.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.



 Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3\-6 years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Experience, Onboarding, Talent Operations, or Candidate Lifecycle Management.



 Success in This Role Means
   

  




* High Interview\-to\-Join Conversion.
* Exceptional Candidate Experience Scores.
* Smooth Day 1 Readiness and Induction Delivery.
* Strong Stakeholder Satisfaction.
* Zero Compliance Gaps.
* Continuous Process Improvement and Automation Adoption.



 Why Join Us?
   

  





 This role provides a unique opportunity to directly influence how employees experience our organization from the very beginning. You will work with senior stakeholders, drive meaningful employee experience outcomes, lead critical onboarding initiatives, and play a pivotal role in shaping the future workforce experience.
   

  





**If you are passionate about people, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to create exceptional employee experiences at scale, we'd love to hear from you.**




  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administrationor a related field.
   

  





 3\-6 years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Experience, Onboarding, Talent Operations, or Candidate Lifecycle Management.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**About the Department \- Human Resources**




 The Human Resources department at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories is the organizational heartbeat, dedicated to fostering a positive and inclusive work environment for their 24,000\+ employees. As a well\-executed Human Resources (HR) team, we foster a positive and productive workplace. Effective HR practices are involved in recruiting and retaining top talent, providing comprehensive employee development programs, and ensuring fair and transparent policies. The robust HR department at Dr. Reddys is cultivating a culture of open communication, employee engagement, and diversity and inclusion. Moreover, it plays a crucial role in conflict resolution, fostering a healthy work environment and aligns organizational goals with the well\-being and professional growth of its employees, contributing significantly to overall company success.
   

  





**Benefits Offered**

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy's are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
   

  





**Our Work Culture**




 Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy's why they come to work every day and they'll say, because Good Health Can't Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we're always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. title: Head of Talent Acquisition
description:
Head of Recruitment / Head of Talent Acquisition
 
**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India — On\-site
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Company:** 
 Linx
 



**Experience:** 
 8–12\+ years, including significant recruitment leadership experience
 


 About Linx
 
 Linx is a global workforce solutions company helping organizations hire, employ, pay and manage talent across international markets. Our solutions span Employer of Record (EOR), Global Payroll, Global Contractors, Talent Acquisition/RPO, BPO and Global Capability Centers (GCC).
 



 As Linx continues to scale, we are looking for a highly analytical, commercially minded
 **Head of Recruitment** 
 to build and lead a high\-performance recruiting organization.
 



 This is not simply a people\-management position.
 



 We need a leader who can
 **forecast demand, translate hiring requirements into capacity plans, understand recruiting economics, analyze funnel performance, identify problems before they become delivery failures and build a recruitment engine capable of scaling rapidly.** 



 The Role
 
 The Head of Recruitment will have end\-to\-end responsibility for recruitment strategy, delivery performance, recruiter productivity, workforce planning and operational discipline.
 



 You will be expected to answer questions such as:
 



**What hiring demand is coming over the next 30, 60 and 90 days?** 




**Do we have enough recruiting capacity to deliver it?** 




**Where are candidates dropping out of the funnel?** 




**Which recruiters are performing—and why?** 




**Which accounts are at risk of missing hiring commitments?** 




**What is our cost per hire?** 




**How quickly can we scale from 20 hires to 200\+ hires?** 




**What recruiting resources will we need before that demand arrives?** 




 We are looking for someone who manages recruitment through
 **data, forecasting and measurable outcomes—not instinct alone.** 



 Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment Strategy \& Leadership
 * Own the overall recruitment strategy across Linx client accounts and internal hiring requirements.
* Build scalable recruiting models for high\-volume, professional, technical, BPO, GCC and international hiring.
* Translate client hiring requirements into actionable recruiting strategies.
* Develop sourcing strategies based on role type, geography, compensation, talent availability and hiring velocity.
* Establish consistent recruiting processes, governance and operating standards.
* Build a culture of accountability, urgency and measurable performance within the recruitment organization.
* Develop recruiters and recruitment managers while addressing performance gaps decisively.


 Forecasting \& Capacity Planning
 
 This will be a critical responsibility of the role.
 


* Build
 **weekly, monthly and quarterly hiring forecasts** 
 based on confirmed and anticipated demand.
* Translate hiring forecasts into recruiter capacity requirements.
* Determine recruiter bandwidth by role complexity, geography and expected hiring volume.
* Forecast sourcing requirements and candidate pipeline needs.
* Identify capacity shortages before they affect client delivery.
* Develop surge hiring strategies for large\-volume requirements.
* Recommend when additional recruiters, sourcers, vendors or technology are required.
* Maintain scenario models for expected, accelerated and reduced hiring demand.
* Work closely with Sales and Account Management to understand upcoming pipeline and anticipate recruitment demand before contracts go live.


 Recruitment Analytics
 
 The Head of Recruitment must be exceptionally comfortable with data.
 



 Own and continuously analyze metrics including:
 


* Time\-to\-fill
* Time\-to\-submit
* Time\-to\-interview
* Time\-to\-offer
* Time\-to\-join
* Submission\-to\-interview ratio
* Interview\-to\-offer ratio
* Offer acceptance rate
* Offer\-to\-join ratio
* Candidate dropout rate
* Source effectiveness
* Recruiter productivity
* Hires per recruiter
* Pipeline coverage
* Aging requisitions
* SLA attainment
* Cost per hire
* Recruitment cost by account
* Hiring forecast vs. actual
* Client/account delivery performance



 The expectation is not simply to
 **report metrics** 
 .
 



 The Head of Recruitment must be able to interpret them, identify root causes and take corrective action.
 


 Goal Setting \& Performance Management
 * Establish measurable weekly, monthly and quarterly goals for recruiters and recruitment managers.
* Create role\-appropriate productivity benchmarks rather than applying identical targets across every hiring category.
* Conduct structured weekly performance reviews based on actual funnel data.
* Identify underperformance early and establish corrective actions.
* Recognize high performers and understand which behaviors and sourcing strategies are driving their results.
* Ensure every recruiter understands their individual goals and how those goals connect to client delivery.
* Build dashboards that allow leadership to see recruitment performance without manually chasing updates.


 Client Delivery \& Account Management
 * Own recruitment delivery against agreed client hiring plans.
* Participate in strategic client conversations where recruitment delivery, scaling or workforce planning is involved.
* Establish realistic hiring timelines based on market data and recruiting capacity.
* Monitor every major account for delivery risk.
* Create recovery plans for accounts falling behind.
* Ensure clients receive accurate, data\-driven updates rather than reactive explanations.
* Partner with Account Management to maintain strong client relationships and proactively address delivery concerns.


 High\-Volume \& Rapid Scaling
 
 Linx may need to support clients requiring significant hiring volume within compressed timelines.
 



 The Head of Recruitment must be capable of designing hiring strategies for
 **dozens or hundreds of hires** 
 , not simply individual requisitions.
 



 This includes:
 


* Hiring\-event strategy
* Recruitment pods
* Dedicated account teams
* Sourcer/recruiter ratios
* Talent\-pool development
* Vendor augmentation
* Geographic sourcing
* Interview capacity planning
* Offer and onboarding coordination
* Ramp forecasting
* Contingency planning



 The leader should be able to take a requirement such as
 **“We need 300 people in the next 90 days”** 
 and convert it into a mathematical and operational hiring plan.
 


 Technology, Automation \& AI
 * Drive adoption of recruitment technology, automation and AI across the hiring lifecycle.
* Use data and technology to reduce manual work and improve recruiter productivity.
* Partner with Linx technology teams to continuously improve recruiting workflows.
* Identify where AI can improve sourcing, screening, interviewing, candidate assessment and pipeline intelligence.
* Ensure technology enhances—not replaces—sound recruiting judgment and candidate experience.


 What We're Looking For
 * **8–12\+ years of recruitment experience** 
 , with meaningful leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience managing recruitment teams and managers.
* Strong experience with
 **high\-volume and/or multi\-client recruitment delivery** 
 .
* Experience with RPO, staffing, BPO, GCC or recruitment services environments is strongly preferred.
* Exceptional analytical ability.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with recruiting dashboards, ATS reporting and BI tools is highly desirable.
* Strong forecasting and workforce\-capacity\-planning capability.
* Ability to translate data into operational decisions.
* Strong understanding of recruitment funnels and conversion ratios.
* Demonstrated ability to establish and manage recruiter productivity metrics.
* Strong commercial understanding of recruitment economics.
* Excellent client\-facing and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a rapidly growing organization.
* Comfortable being held accountable for measurable outcomes.


 The Person We Want
 
 We are
 **not** 
 looking for someone whose primary strength is managing recruiter activity.
 



 We want someone who thinks like an
 **operator** 
 .
 



 You should naturally look at a recruitment operation and ask:
 



**What does the data tell me?** 




**What is going to happen next?** 




**Where is the bottleneck?** 




**What capacity do I need?** 




**What will prevent us from hitting the goal?** 




**What is the corrective action?** 




 You should be comfortable challenging assumptions with data and making difficult decisions when performance isn't where it needs to be.
 



 You should be equally comfortable discussing a candidate funnel with a recruiter, a delivery forecast with a client, and recruitment economics with the CEO.
 


 First 90 Days
 
 The successful candidate will be expected to:
 



**First 30 Days — Diagnose** 




 Understand every recruiter, client account, open requirement, existing process and technology platform. Establish baseline performance across the recruitment funnel.
 



**Days 31–60 — Build** 




 Implement dashboards, recruiter scorecards, account\-level delivery tracking, forecasting models, capacity planning and standardized operating rhythms.
 



**Days 61–90 — Optimize** 




 Identify productivity gaps, restructure resources where necessary, establish predictable hiring forecasts and present leadership with a scalable recruitment operating model.
 



 By Day 90, leadership should be able to see clearly:
 



**Demand → Pipeline → Capacity → Conversion → Hires → Risk → Forecast** 




 without having to chase the recruitment organization for answers.
 


 What Success Looks Like
 
 Success is not measured by how busy the recruitment team appears.
 



 It is measured by whether Linx can
 **predictably deliver hiring outcomes.** 




 We should know what we can deliver, when we can deliver it, what resources are required, where we are falling behind and what action is being taken.
 



 The Head of Recruitment will ultimately be accountable for building a recruiting organization that is
 **analytical, predictable, scalable and relentlessly focused on delivery.**

description:
Technical Recruiter
 



  





 Location: Hyderabad, India
 



 Work Model: On\-site
 



 Company: Linx
 



 Experience: 3–6 years
 



  





 About Linx
 



  





 Linx helps companies build and manage teams globally through Employer of Record (EOR), Global Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and Global Capability Center (GCC) solutions.
 



  





 As we continue to scale our global recruiting operations, we are looking for a Technical Recruiter who knows how to find exceptional talent — not simply process applications.
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on Technical Recruiter who can own technical searches from requirement intake through offer acceptance.
 



  





 You should be comfortable recruiting across:
 



  





 \* Software Engineering
 



 \* Data \& Analytics
 



 \* AI / Machine Learning
 



 \* Cloud \& DevOps
 



 \* Cybersecurity
 



 \* Product \& Technical Program Management
 



 \* QA / Automation
 



 \* Enterprise Applications
 



  





 This is a delivery\-focused role. You’ll work closely with hiring managers and recruiting leadership to understand requirements, develop sourcing strategies, engage passive candidates, and close positions quickly without compromising quality.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 



  





 Own the search. Understand the role beyond the job description — technology stack, seniority, compensation, team structure and what actually makes someone successful.
 



  





 Source proactively. Build pipelines through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, databases and creative sourcing techniques rather than relying on inbound applications.
 



  





 Evaluate technical talent. Conduct strong recruiter screens and understand technology well enough to distinguish genuine hands\-on experience from keywords on a résumé.
 



  





 Manage the entire recruiting lifecycle. Sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate engagement, feedback, offer negotiation and closure.
 



  





 Partner with hiring managers. Challenge requirements when necessary, recalibrate searches quickly and provide real market intelligence.
 



  





 Recruit globally. Support technical hiring across India, the US and other international markets based on client requirements.
 



  





 Maintain recruiting discipline. Keep ATS data accurate and provide clear visibility into submissions, interviews, offers, closures and bottlenecks.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 \* 3–6 years of hands\-on technical recruiting experience
 



 \* Strong experience sourcing passive technical candidates
 



 \* Good understanding of modern technology roles and terminology
 



 \* Strong LinkedIn Recruiter and Boolean search skills
 



 \* Ability to manage multiple open requirements simultaneously
 



 \* Excellent written and verbal communication
 



 \* Strong candidate assessment and negotiation skills
 



 \* Experience supporting US or international technical hiring strongly preferred
 



 \* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven environment
 



  





 How We Measure Success
 



  





 We care about outcomes, not résumé volume.
 



  





 Quality of submission → Interview conversion → Offer conversion → Time to fill → Joining ratio → Hiring\-manager/client satisfaction
 



  





 Sending 50 average profiles isn’t more successful than sending 10 excellent ones.
 



  





 A Note About Our Interview Process
 



  





 At Linx, we’re building the future of recruiting — and we believe our own candidates should experience the technology we’re creating.
 



  





 The first step in the interview process for this role is a Lexy AI interview.
 



  





 It’s an opportunity for us to learn more about your experience, approach to recruiting and how you think, while also giving you firsthand experience with the AI recruiting technology that is becoming part of how we work.
 



  





 We’re looking for recruiters who are curious about technology and comfortable working in an environment where AI and human judgment work together.
 



  





 If participating in an AI interview isn’t something you’re comfortable with or interested in, we completely respect that. This particular opportunity, however, may not be the right fit, and we’d encourage you to consider that before applying.
 



  





 Who Will Do Well Here
 



  





 Someone who is curious, persistent and commercially minded.
 



  





 You enjoy difficult searches. You know how to find candidates other recruiters can’t. You follow up relentlessly, communicate well and understand that candidate experience matters.
 



  





 When someone says:
 



  





 “We’ve been trying to fill this position for three months.”
 



  





 Your instinct is:
 



  





 “Give me the requirement.”
 



  





 If that’s how you recruit — and you’re excited about how AI is changing our industry — we’d like to meet you.

description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 As a Recruiter at Wise you’ll be responsible for hiring the best talent for Product Engineering in Hyderabad. You’ll own talent management, helping ProdEng to scale to enable Wise to achieve our mission \- money without borders. You’ll be a key member of the recruitment team with a focus on delivering exceptional talent while keeping candidate and hiring manager experience front and centre of what you do.
   

  

 Culture is everything to us at Wise and identifying, finding and selecting the best talent to support our highly collaborative and non\-hierarchical culture is key. As a Recruiter you are vital to the overall success of Wise. The right person will have an excellent knowledge of talent management and understand how to partner effectively.
   

  

**Your Mission**
* You’ll help us scale our ProdEng teams over the next few years so we can help more customers save money using Wise
* You’ll manage candidates end\-to\-end ensuring they receive the best possible experience in line with Wise values, even if they weren’t successful (you never know, the perfect role might come up later), and build a strong talent network locally and internationally
* You’ll build and develop relationships with with hiring teams, guiding them through processes
* Always seeking growth opportunities, not afraid to step outside of your comfort zone and take a risk
* Collaborate with sourcers to understand the candidate market and engage the best talent
* Use data to support your hiring recommendations, as well as using it to retro processes, figure out the blockers to hiring, communicate how these can be overcome and continually optimise the process to make sure it is globally scalable
* You'll partner with hiring teams and other People teams (e.g. People Operations), to support various initiatives (e.g. referral programs, talent mapping, salary benchmarking, etc)
* Lead and execute targeted talent acquisition strategies, including campus recruitment programs and weekend hiring drives, to scale the talent pipeline efficiently.


**Qualifications**
 A bit about you:
   

  

* You have a proven track record of hiring exceptional talent while delivering the best partnering experience to candidates and hiring teams for 5\+ years
* You are an adaptable self\-starter \- someone who can use their own initiative to keep things running at pace and won’t wait for answers
* You are good with tooling and make data driven decisions by running reports, building dashboards and implementing new systems
* You are resilient and curious by nature \- you like flipping ambiguity, failures and set\-backs in their head by actually using them as learning opportunities
* You are a creative problem solver. A tricky role won’t get you down. It’s a challenge that just spurs you on to find a new approach and try something new. You're curious and get a real kick out of learning different skills
* You are a confident communicator and influencer, comfortable talking to people of any level, whether it’s in person, on the phone or in writing. You understand how best to adapt your approach to your audience


 Key Attributes
   

  

* Data Driven. You’re able to use data to build narratives and influence change. You can make evidence\-based decisions and you’re able to use data to measure impact
* Flexible \& adaptable. You’re able to switch effectively between tasks and deal with constantly\-changing workload and priorities.
* Initiative. You’re able to identify and seize opportunities. You can work with limited guidance to solve problems.
* Big Thinker. You understand the impact of your work on the success of the company. You’re able to create well thought\-through action plans built around the big picture. You consider others and you’re aware of the impact your work has on other teams. You’re always thinking and planning for scalable and sustainable solutions


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

 We are seeking an experienced RPO Resourcing Partner to join our team in an exciting client partnership role based at our GBS in Hyderabad. **Meet Our Team**
 Pega’s Talent Advisory Team provides timely, accurate, and straightforward advice on people strategies, organizational development, talent management, employee issues, local labor laws, compliance, and corporate directives.
   

  

**Picture Yourself At Pega**
 Pega’s vision is to change how the world builds software, and while our technology and business encompass what we do, our culture drives how we get the job done. As a Talent Advisory Partner, you will be supporting and coaching our managers to drive a high\-performance culture. If you are passionate about supporting and helping others and driving organization success through HR excellence, we encourage you to apply. This is a hybrid role, with 2\-3 days in\-office.
   

  

 At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
   

  

 We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

* HR Consulting: Act as an internal consultant to functional units, developing and executing HR solutions to address critical organizational issues.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders to facilitate effective collaboration and understanding of HR practices.
* Strategic Alignment: Understand business priorities to create and implement HR strategies that support functional needs and drive success.

* Collaborative \& Autonomous: You work well both independently and as part of a team, and are motivated to make an impactful contribution.
* Confident \& Pragmatic: You can comfortably address all levels of the organization, providing pragmatic solutions to conflicts.
* Diversity Advocate: You are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel for ad hoc reporting.
* Strong proficiency with PowerPoint presentations, telling a story through data. Power BI or similar data visualization tools is strongly preferred.

You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.

* Technical HR Knowledge: Familiar with HR functions such as employee relations related to performance management, role eliminations and organizational design.
* Data\-Driven: Experience analyzing HR data trends to inform decisions and enhance HR offerings.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate long\-term objectives into actionable, impactful plans.
* Leadership Coaching: Experience in coaching leaders on HR best practices to enhance their effectiveness.

* Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.

* An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices
